name: zapier
description: Connect to 9000+ apps and 30000+ actions through the Zapier MCP server — send Slack messages, create Sheets rows, manage Jira/Asana tasks, update HubSpot deals, post Discord messages, and more, all through natural language.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to 9000+ apps through the Zapier MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can connect to over 9,000 apps through Zapier — sending Slack messages, creating Google Sheets rows, managing Asana tasks, updating HubSpot deals, and thousands more actions. No custom API code needed: just tell your agent what you want to do across your apps, and it handles the integration through your configured Zapier connections.
defaultPrompt: Send a message to Slack about this update.
Create a new row in my Google Sheet with this data.
Show me what actions I have configured in my Zapier account.
